# routeur_moderation_settings (Resource)

The organisation-wide output-moderation settings: a singleton that always exists, so creating it takes it over and destroying it resets it to the routeur.ai default (`buffered`). Import it with the organisation slug. Requires a routeur.ai plan with output moderation to change.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One per organisation. Destroying it resets the default to `buffered`.
resource "routeur_moderation_settings" "this" {
  streaming_moderation = "chunked"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `streaming_moderation` (String) How output moderation applies to streamed responses across the organisation: `buffered` scans the whole response before sending a byte and never leaks blocked content; `chunked` scans as tokens stream, which lowers latency but may disclose content before a block. A rule's own `streaming` overrides it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organisation slug.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# id: the organisation slug
import {
  to = routeur_moderation_settings.this
  id = "acme"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# the organisation slug
terraform import routeur_moderation_settings.this acme
```
